lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters positioned posterior to the gill area, forming a roughly rectangular grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor points in a lattice formation.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features running longitudinally along the upper flank exhibit a marked gradient, with peak luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, scattered high-intensity spots are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing lower density compared to the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of smaller, densely packed high-luminance spots along its leading edge and dorsal surface.
